cards.extra:
echo '== imports'; I=$(go list -e -overlay $P/overlay.json -f '{{join .Imports " "}}' ./users) || exit 1; for i in $I; do case $i in crypto/sha256|crypto/subtle|encoding/hex|encoding/json|errors|fmt|os|path/filepath|regexp|sort|strings|time) ;; *) echo "imports: package users imports $i (allowed: crypto/sha256, crypto/subtle, encoding/hex, encoding/json, errors, fmt, os, path/filepath, regexp, sort, strings, time)"; exit 1;; esac; done
echo '== clock'; C=$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Now -> time.Time' users/registry.go 2>&1)$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Since -> time.Time' users/registry.go 2>&1); [ -z "$C" ] || { echo "clock: users/registry.go reads time.Now or time.Since (the clock is the caller's CreatedAt)"; exit 1; }
